### 1. Scene
A mixed hot meal: chicken in tomato-based sauce, a cheese-topped baked portion, a dark browned patty or fritter, a little rice and vegetables, broccoli, and creamy dressed lettuce.

### 2. Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate. Allowing for its shape, I estimate an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm**:  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **530 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Identifications are approximate, especially the browned patty and cheese-topped bake. Sauce and dressing are included in their respective items.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lettuce with creamy dressing | 27% | 143 cm² × 3 cm = 429 ml | 0.18 | 77 g | 100 | 77 kcal |
| Chicken pieces with tomato sauce | 20% | 106 × 1.5 = 159 ml | 0.95 | 151 g | 190 | 287 kcal |
| Cheese-topped baked portion | 14% | 74 × 2 = 148 ml | 0.95 | 141 g | 220 | 310 kcal |
| Dark browned patty/fritter | 7% | 37 × 1.4 = 52 ml | 0.95 | 49 g | 240 | 118 kcal |
| Cooked rice | 8% | 42 × 1 = 42 ml | 0.8 | 34 g | 130 | 44 kcal |
| Mixed cooked vegetables, including tomato and zucchini | 6% | 32 × 1 = 32 ml | 0.6 | 19 g | 60 | 11 kcal |
| Broccoli | 6% | 32 × 2 = 64 ml | 0.55 | 35 g | 35 | 12 kcal |

**Area check:** 88% covered, with approximately 12% exposed plate.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **506 g and about 860 kcal**. That is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate: the rice and scattered vegetables contribute relatively little weight, while the chicken and dense cheesy bake account for most of the energy. Preparation and uncertain food identification could materially change the calorie estimate.
